QF.id: VIII Introduction to Clearing and Settlement System_9

question.text: SPAN (Standard Portfolio Analysis of Risk) margin system is used for:

answer.text: Computing the initial margin by simulating a portfolio's maximum potential loss across multiple market scenarios
Calculating the brokerage charges for each trade
Determining the settlement price of futures contracts

explanation.text: The Logic: SPAN evaluates potential portfolio loss over specified market conditions / risk arrays and sets initial margin to cover the largest reasonably expected one-day loss on the portfolio. It is a risk-based, portfolio-level margining system used by clearing corporations. The Trap: SPAN does not compute brokerage, settlement prices or STT - it is purely a margin-computation methodology for initial margin. Note: Source: NISM-Series-VIII workbook (Dec 2025), pages 160-161.
